challenge.method: Challenged language identity against an implementation-only reading and final ANSI attribution using the exact cover and purpose, scope, and exclusion clauses. Rechecked the committee link and the archive document.
challenge.results: The PDF is a committee draft proposed to replace ANSI X3.215-1994. It supplies a document-scoped language identity and abstract system interface. It supplies no final ANSI status or identity of a particular system.

limitations: The PDF cover describes a proposed replacement for ANSI X3.215-1994. Its language boundary is independent of a particular Forth system and does not assert final ANSI status.
